items.headline: State Police detective charged with DUI after stop on North Main Road
items.blurb: Jamestown police stopped an SUV driving on two flat tires on North Main Road late Oct. 15 and charged its driver, a state police detective from East Greenwich, with suspicion of DUI and refusing a chemical test. State Police called it an open personnel matter.

items.headline: Cold-case investigation leads to murder charge in 1985 death of Jamestown woman
items.blurb: Rhode Island Attorney General Peter Neronha and Newport police announced that William Morton, 61, was charged on October 6 with one count of murder in connection with the 1985 death of a 22-year-old Jamestown woman in Newport. Investigators say renewed forensic DNA analysis helped identify a suspect. Morton was held without bail following his arraignment; the charge is an allegation, and he is presumed innocent unless proven guilty. Jamestown Island News is withholding the victim’s name out of consideration for her family’s privacy.

items.headline: Jamestown man arrested on reckless driving warrant
items.blurb: Rhode Island State Police arrested a 52-year-old Jamestown man at his Howland Avenue home on a reckless driving warrant. He was arraigned and released with a court date.
